scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core apps/api apps/mcp-server && pnpm --filter @atlas/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core apps/api apps/mcp-server && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,web "tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core --watch" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --import tsx --watch apps/api/src/index.ts" "pnpm --filter @atlas/web dev"
scripts.test:db: pnpm build:shared && node --env-file=.local/test.env --import tsx node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config tests/vitest.db.config.ts
scripts.db:test:start: pnpm db:test:prepare && docker compose --env-file .local/test.env -p atlas-tests -f infra/compose.test.yml up -d --wait && node --env-file=.local/test.env --import tsx scripts/bootstrap-test-db.ts
scripts.test:security: pnpm build:shared && node --env-file=.local/test.env --import tsx node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config tests/vitest.db.config.ts tests/integration/authorization.test.ts tests/integration/owner-organization.test.ts
scripts.owner:bind:neon: pnpm build:shared && node --import tsx scripts/bind-owner.ts neon
